description: I led the modularization of Eurobank's mobile banking app, creating 10+ feature modules split along the project's architecture, and helped raise unit test coverage by 6% through that work and new unit tests. I own features for insurance and account products such as Happy Pet pet insurance, under-18 accounts and the Travellers card: new steps in their flows, Terms & Conditions moved from static files to dynamic content, and new and fixed Google Analytics events. I also coordinated a production release, owning the release branch and the release pipelines. Team of 35–40 Android developers.

I built native Jetpack Compose/MVI screens that replaced WebView in the Sportsbook, owning parts of the Bet Slip and the live and settled bet counters (corners, cards and more). I created 8+ feature modules in a team-wide effort that raised crash-free sessions from 94.0% to 98% through modularization and removal of duplicate code. For per-brand theming, I used AI to generate design tokens (colors, dimensions, typography) from Figma designs, so each brand's look changes without code changes. I hit the quarterly target of a QA rejection rate below 3% and reviewed 50+ pull requests a quarter. Team of 20–25 Android developers.

I owned tablet and landscape support across 35+ screens of the Viva.com Terminal POS app, used by 1M+ people in 10+ countries, working closely with designers and making the implementation decisions. That opened the app to cash machines and vending machines. I built its Kiosk mode and, as main developer guiding a second developer, led the rebranding from VivaWallet to Viva.com: new Lottie animations, new primary and secondary button colors, and updated components and assets.

Where I grew into a tech lead. I built and maintained 15+ Android apps for insurance and loyalty clients, often as the sole Android developer. I helped build Piraeus Bank's Yellow (a top banking app in Greece for five years) and the award-winning KRAFT Pro App as part of the team, then supported both in production as the sole Android developer. As tech lead I owned estimations, worked directly with clients and mentored junior developers.
